visual.general_description: Vertical flowchart of eight stacked colored boxes joined by downward arrows, ending in a box reading Complete Clinical Resolution of Papilloma.
visual.detailed_description: Eight boxes are stacked top to bottom on a light gray background, linked by short downward arrows. From top: a purple box reading Topical Application of Molecular Iodine; a magenta box reading Rapid Penetration Into Lesion Surface; a large dark teal box reading Direct Anti-Viral and Cytotoxic Effects with two lines below it, Oxidation of viral proteins and nucleic acids and Disruption of infected epithelial cells; a light blue box reading Reduction of Viral Load in Lesion; a green box reading Immune System Engagement with two lines, Recruitment of innate immune cells and Stimulation of adaptive response; a medium blue box reading Clearance of Infected Tissue; an orange box with a black outline reading Tissue Repair and Epithelial Regeneration; and a dark teal box reading Complete Clinical Resolution of Papilloma. No patient image, axis, scale or panel letter is present.

panels.general_description: Vertical flowchart of eight stacked colored boxes joined by downward arrows, ending in Complete Clinical Resolution of Papilloma.
panels.detailed_description: Eight colored text boxes stacked top to bottom with short downward arrows between consecutive boxes; the box texts read Topical Application of Molecular Iodine, Rapid Penetration Into Lesion Surface, Direct Anti-Viral and Cytotoxic Effects, Reduction of Viral Load in Lesion, Immune System Engagement, Clearance of Infected Tissue, Tissue Repair and Epithelial Regeneration, Complete Clinical Resolution of Papilloma.

evidence.quote:
Figure 5
Proposed mechanism of action of molecular iodine in oral papilloma resolution.Topical molecular iodine penetrates the lesion surface, producing direct antiviral and cytotoxic effects through oxidation of viral proteins and nucleic acids and disruption of infected epithelial cells [7,11]. This reduces viral load and facilitates immune system engagement, including recruitment of innate immune cells and stimulation of adaptive immunity. The combined effects result in clearance of infected tissue, followed by epithelial repair and complete clinical resolution of the papilloma [25,26].Original schematic created by the author. Mechanistic steps informed by previously published data [7,11,25,26].
